intro: Trying to find undergraduate scholarships in South Carolina that take financial need into account usually means sorting through programs with very different rules, award sizes, and timelines. This filtered USA view brings those listings into one place so you can compare options more quickly and decide where to apply first. The programs below span categories such as community, humanities, education, and miscellaneous, and some may fit students in education or history-related paths. Award amounts vary by listing and should be verified on each official page. Deadlines also differ by program, and with some dates appearing relatively soon in the current set, it is smart to check the rows promptly. Many listings here appear to have lighter application requirements, and many may not require an essay, but you should still confirm every detail before applying.
